messages:
anna_k: Heads-up — FinOps flagged ~$45k of GPU spend last billing cycle that didn't have service/product tags. Looks mostly in us-west2 preemptible pool. Anyone on this?

mike_p: yikes. which label keys are missing?

anna_k: resource.labels.gpu_owner and resource.labels.product. BigQuery export shows a lot of compute.googleapis.com/resource_name like 'nvidia-a100-80gb' with null labels.

jess_t: I saw this on the daily report — suspected cause is the new autoscaler we rolled two weeks ago that created nodepools without the label injection hook.

raj_s: ah right — the hook lives in infra-helpers helm chart. We had a failed daemonset rollout on 2026-07-12, that would match timeline.

mike_p: can we confirm which teams got hit? query I ran: 
```sql
SELECT COALESCE(labels['product'], 'untagged') AS product, SUM(cost) AS spend
FROM `billing.gcp_export_*`
WHERE service.description LIKE '%Compute Engine%'
  AND sku.description LIKE '%GPU%'
GROUP BY product
ORDER BY spend DESC
```
returns top rows: untagged $45,122, search-team $12,300, embeddings $8,900.

finops-bot: @anna_k @mike_p new invoice alert created: invoice-2026-07 (potential retro charge)

jess_t: root cause path: failed daemonset -> autoscaler created nodes via nodepool template that didn't run label-injector init -> nodes lacked kubelet node-label annotation -> provisioner didn't set resource labels on instances.

anna_k: proposal: 1) backfill labels on instances where possible, 2) run a billing export reprocess to attribute historical costs, 3) patch autoscaler templates + add preflight check in CI, 4) schedule chargeback adjustment for affected product owners.

raj_s: backfill plan: we have a GCP API script that can set metadata on instances; for terminated VMs costs are already in export so we'll need to map by instance id/time and set billing labels via BigQuery mapping for reprocessing. I'll start drafting a runbook. ETA for script: today EOD.

mike_p: FinOps: can you confirm if GCP will accept retroactive labels for cost attribution? I thought labels only apply going forward.

finops-bot: GCP: some labels retroactive in billing export if set via API and modified before export snapshot, but not guaranteed. Usually we reprocess export and do mapping in BigQuery for historical attribution. Recommend ledger mapping approach.

jess_t: ok so we'll do BigQuery mapping. Raj can you add a mapping table keyed by instance_id -> product, owner, start_ts, end_ts? then update our cost dashboard and re-run top-level chargeback calc.

raj_s: yep. I'll create table infra.node_label_backfill and populate from instance metadata + kube events. starting now.

anna_k: timeline? we need a comms plan to teams affected and to billing owners.

mike_p: timeline: backfill mapping by tomorrow noon, update dashboards by tomorrow 5pm, submit internal chargeback adjustment for July by Fri.

jess_t: +1. I'll also add a CI gate so any nodepool template missing label-injector or required metadata fails validation.

anna_k: action owners: raj (backfill script + table), jess (CI gate + helm chart fix), mike (chargeback calc + comms), anna (notify execs + track).

finops-bot: noted. tagging invoice-2026-07 as "investigation-in-flight".

mike_p: one more thing — let's ensure reserved capacity commitments are mapped to cost centers properly. Some dedicated capacity in europe was billed under a shared sku earlier and missed allocation tags. I'll open a follow-up thread for reserved commitments reconciliation.

anna_k: good call. For this thread let's focus on backfill and immediate chargeback. I'll post a short summary to #finance after Raj confirms mapping table. :thumbsup:

raj_s: update: table created with initial 2k rows, running validation now. will ping when cleaned.

jess_t: thanks team.

anna_k: closing loop later today — anyone escalate to incident if we see >$50k untagged?

mike_p: escalate if >$30k to lead execs.

anna_k: noted.
